stem: A client is scheduled for a serum lipid panel whose laboratory profile specifies “Fasting (8 HR or more).” Which instruction is most accurate?

options.A: Eat a light meal two hours before collection because food intake does not affect preparation for this specified profile.
options.B: Follow the laboratory requirement and complete at least 8 hours of fasting before the specimen is collected.
options.C: Fast for about one hour before collection because a longer fast interferes with interpretation of this laboratory profile.
options.D: Withhold prescribed morning medications automatically because the fasting instruction also directs routine medication interruption.

rationale: The current Mayo Clinic Laboratories LPSC1 lipid-panel catalog explicitly lists 'Fasting (8 HR or more)' in both Profile Information and the order question RAWF. Therefore B follows the test-specific requirement exactly. A and C do not meet the specified duration. D adds a medication-withholding rule that is not contained in the cited fasting instruction and should not be inferred from it.
educational_objective: Follow the exact laboratory preparation requirement specified for an ordered test without converting a fasting instruction into unsupported medication restrictions.
source_version_date: Current online Test Catalog; live page retrieved 2026-08-26
source_locator: Profile Information: INTC1 — Fasting (8 HR or more), always performed; Order Questions and Answers: RAWF — Fasting (8 HR or more), Raw.
source_claim_supported: This specific Mayo lipid-panel profile requires fasting for 8 hours or more.
blueprint_locator: Reduction of Risk Potential — preparation for laboratory/diagnostic testing and interpretation of results.
correction_summary: Removed only/all cueing and preserved the exact laboratory-specific fasting interval without adding medication instructions.

audit_findings.independent_adversarial_second_pass: PASS — Mayo explicitly requires ≥8 hours; no source supports automatic medication withholding from this instruction.
